upstream_issues.title: ZapfDingbats built-in encoding loses ITC glyph mappings and reports incorrect advances
upstream_issues.summary: The built-in ZapfDingbats font loses ITC Unicode mappings and reports incorrect glyph advances: code 108 (`a71`) decodes to an empty string with horizontal displacement 1.000 instead of U+25CF with advance 0.791; code 32 (`space`) advances by 0.790 rather than the Adobe AFM value 0.278.
upstream_issues.reproduction:
```python
from playa.font import Type1Font
from playa.parser import LIT

font = Type1Font({
    "Type": LIT("Font"),
    "Subtype": LIT("Type1"),
    "BaseFont": LIT("ZapfDingbats"),
})
print(font.encoding[108])
print(list(font.decode(b"l")))
print(font.hdisp(108))
print(font.hdisp(32))
```
upstream_issues.actual_behavior: Code 108 loses U+25CF and advances by 1.000; space advances by 0.790.
upstream_issues.expected_behavior: Adobe ITC maps a71 to U+25CF; Adobe AFM gives advances 0.791 and 0.278.
upstream_issues.relevant_implementation: AGL-only name lookup omits ITC names, and the Unicode-keyed Core 14 metrics contain an incorrect space width.

upstream_issues.title: Compiled PNG Average predictor overflows before division and differs from the Python source
upstream_issues.summary: The compiled `playa.utils.apply_png_predictor` produces a different decoded byte from the Python source shipped in the same installed package. A six-byte input reproduces the problem without an external PDF.
upstream_issues.reproduction:
```python
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import playa.utils

encoded = bytes([0, 200, 200, 3, 100, 0])
print(list(playa.utils.apply_png_predictor(15, 1, 2, 8, encoded)))

# Load the Python source included beside the compiled extension.
source = Path(playa.utils.__file__).with_name("utils.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("playa._pure_utils", source)
pure = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(pure)
print(list(pure.apply_png_predictor(15, 1, 2, 8, encoded)))
```
upstream_issues.expected_behavior: The same shipped Python source and the PNG specification yield [200, 200, 200, 200].
upstream_issues.relevant_implementation: The compiled Average predictor narrows the left-plus-above sum before division rather than preserving at least nine bits.
